description.sl: 24. december, sveti večer. Oma Resi okrasi drevesce in speče piškote, zazvoni zvonček in darila prinese Jezušček.
description.en: 24 December, Christmas Eve. Oma Resi decorates the tree and bakes biscuits, a little bell rings and the Christ Child brings the presents.
description.it: 24 dicembre, la Vigilia. Oma Resi decora l'albero e prepara i biscotti, suona un campanellino e Gesù Bambino porta i regali.

words.example_de: Zu Weihnachten sind wir alle zu Hause.
words.example_en: At Christmas we're all at home.
words.example_it: A Natale siamo tutti a casa.
words.note: Mostly without an article: zu Weihnachten.
words.note_it: Di solito senza articolo: zu Weihnachten.

words.example_en: The Christ Child brings the presents.
words.example_it: I regali li porta Gesù Bambino.
words.note: In Austria the Christ Child, not Father Christmas, brings the presents on Christmas Eve.
words.note_sl: V Avstriji darila na sveti večer prinese Jezušček, ne Božiček.
words.note_it: In Austria i regali della Vigilia li porta Gesù Bambino, non Babbo Natale.

words.example_de: Der Christbaum hat Kerzen und Sterne.
words.example_sl: Božično drevo ima sveče in zvezde.
words.example_en: The Christmas tree has candles and stars.
words.example_it: L'albero di Natale ha candele e stelle.

words.example_de: Unter dem Baum liegt ein Geschenk für dich.
words.example_en: There's a present for you under the tree.
words.example_it: Sotto l'albero c'è un regalo per te.

words.example_de: Oma Resi backt Vanillekipferl und andere Kekse.
words.example_sl: Oma Resi peče vaniljeve rogljičke in druge piškote.
words.example_en: Oma Resi bakes vanilla crescents and other biscuits.
words.example_it: Oma Resi prepara i Vanillekipferl e altri biscotti.
